name: Haus Margit
beschreibung: The Haus Margit is located on Darreweg in Serfaus, combining a peaceful environment with easy walking access to the village centre on Tyrol's sunny plateau. The spacious accommodation caters perfectly to families and self-catering travellers, offering multiple bedrooms, modern bathrooms, and an inviting living area complete with a warming fireplace. The fully fitted kitchen enables flexible cooking, while traditional restaurants and bakeries are just a short stroll away. In a matter of minutes, guests can reach the Serfaus underground station for rapid transport to the main mountain lifts. Summer offers panoramic mountain trails, while winter delivers world-class skiing across Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis.
kurzbeschreibung: Centrally yet quietly located holiday home on Darreweg in Serfaus with a fully equipped kitchen and cosy fireplace.
